newsitem.title: USA: Three Rivers 5.5 pct stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Three Rivers 5.5 pct stake held by group.

text.p: A group including New York investor Jeffrey Gendell said it holds a 5.5 percent stake or 47,600 common shares in Three Rivers Financial Corp.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it most recently purchased 6,600 shares between April 4 and April 9 at $13.79 to $14.06 each.

The group said it holds shares in the Three Rivers, Mich. bank holding company for investment purposes. However, the group said it will "pursue discussions with management to maximize long-term value for shareholders."
